verses.original: Τὸν μὲν πρῶτον λόγον ἐποιησάμην περὶ πάντων ὦ Θεόφιλε ὧν ἤρξατο ὁ Ἰησοῦς ποιεῖν τε καὶ διδάσκειν
verses.transliteration: Ton men prōton logon epoiēsamēn peri pantōn ō Theophile hōn ērxato ho Iēsous poiein te kai didaskein
verses.literal: In my first book O Theophilus I wrote about all that Jesus began to do and to teach
verses.literalPt: No primeiro livro relatei, ó Teófilo, todas as coisas que Jesus começou a fazer e a ensinar

verses.original: ἄχρι ἧς ἡμέρας ἐντειλάμενος τοῖς ἀποστόλοις διὰ Πνεύματος Ἁγίου οὓς ἐξελέξατο ἀνελήμφθη
verses.transliteration: achri hēs hēmeras enteilamenos tois apostolois dia Pneumatos Hagiou hous exelexato anelēmphthē
verses.literal: until the day He was taken up to heaven after giving instructions through the Holy Spirit to the apostles He had chosen
verses.literalPt: até o dia em que foi recebido acima, depois de haver dado preceitos pelo Espírito Santo aos apóstolos que escolhera;

verses.original: οἷς καὶ παρέστησεν ἑαυτὸν ζῶντα μετὰ τὸ παθεῖν αὐτὸν ἐν πολλοῖς τεκμηρίοις δι’ ἡμερῶν τεσσεράκοντα ὀπτανόμενος αὐτοῖς καὶ λέγων τὰ περὶ τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: hois kai parestēsen heauton zōnta meta to pathein auton en pollois tekmēriois di’ hēmerōn tesserakonta optanomenos autois kai legōn ta peri tēs basileias tou Theou
verses.literal: After His suffering He presented Himself to them with many convincing proofs that He was alive He appeared to them over a span of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God
verses.literalPt: aos quais ele também, depois de haver padecido, apresentou-se vivo, dando disso muitas provas, aparecendo-lhes por espaço de quarenta dias e falando das coisas concernentes ao reino de Deus.

verses.original: Καὶ συναλιζόμενος παρήγγειλεν αὐτοῖς ἀπὸ Ἱεροσολύμων μὴ χωρίζεσθαι ἀλλὰ περιμένειν τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν τοῦ Πατρὸς Ἣν ἠκούσατέ μου
verses.transliteration: Kai synalizomenos parēngeilen autois apo Hierosolymōn mē chōrizesthai alla perimenein tēn epangelian tou Patros Hēn ēkousate mou
verses.literal: And while they were gathered together He commanded them Do not leave . . . Jerusalem but wait for the gift the Father promised which you have heard Me discuss
verses.literalPt: Reunido a eles, ordenou-lhes que não saíssem de Jerusalém, mas que esperassem a promessa feita pelo Pai, a qual (disse ele) de mim ouvistes;

verses.original: ὅτι Ἰωάννης μὲν ἐβάπτισεν ὕδατι ὑμεῖς δὲ ἐν Πνεύματι βαπτισθήσεσθε Ἁγίῳ οὐ μετὰ πολλὰς ταύτας ἡμέρας
verses.transliteration: hoti Iōannēs men ebaptisen hydati hymeis de en Pneumati baptisthēsesthe Hagiō ou meta pollas tautas hēmeras
verses.literal: For . . . John baptized with water but in a few days - you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit
verses.literalPt: pois João, na verdade, batizou com água, mas vós sereis batizados com o Espírito Santo, dentro de poucos dias.

verses.original: Οἱ μὲν οὖν συνελθόντες ἠρώτων αὐτὸν λέγοντες Κύριε εἰ ἐν τῷ χρόνῳ τούτῳ ἀποκαθιστάνεις τὴν βασιλείαν τῷ Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: Hoi men oun synelthontes ērōtōn auton legontes Kyrie ei en tō chronō toutō apokathistaneis tēn basileian tō Israēl
verses.literal: So when they came together they asked Him Lord will You at this time restore the kingdom to Israel
verses.literalPt: Eles, estando reunidos outra vez, perguntaram-lhe: Senhor, é agora, porventura, que restabeleces o reino a Israel?

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς Οὐχ ὑμῶν ἐστιν γνῶναι χρόνους ἢ καιροὺς οὓς ὁ Πατὴρ ἔθετο ἐν τῇ ἰδίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Eipen de pros autous Ouch hymōn estin gnōnai chronous ē kairous hous ho Patēr etheto en tē idia exousia
verses.literal: Jesus replied . . . . . . It is not for you to know times or seasons that the Father has fixed by His own authority
verses.literalPt: Ele lhes respondeu: A vós não vos compete saber os tempos ou as épocas que o Pai fixou pela sua própria autoridade;

verses.original: ἀλλὰ λήμψεσθε δύναμιν ἐπελθόντος τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς καὶ ἔσεσθέ μου μάρτυρες ἔν τε Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ ἐν πάσῃ τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ καὶ Σαμαρείᾳ καὶ ἕως ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: alla lēmpsesthe dynamin epelthontos tou Hagiou Pneumatos eph’ hymas kai esesthe mou martyres en te Ierousalēm kai en pasē tē Ioudaia kai Samareia kai heōs eschatou tēs gēs
verses.literal: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you and you will be My witnesses in Jerusalem and in all Judea and Samaria and to the ends of the earth
verses.literalPt: mas recebereis poder, ao descer sobre vós o Espírito Santo, e sereis minhas testemunhas tanto em Jerusalém como em toda a Judeia e Samaria e até as extremidades da terra.

verses.original: Καὶ ταῦτα εἰπὼν βλεπόντων αὐτῶν ἐπήρθη καὶ νεφέλη ὑπέλαβεν αὐτὸν ἀπὸ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai tauta eipōn blepontōn autōn epērthē kai nephelē hypelaben auton apo tōn ophthalmōn autōn
verses.literal: After He had said this they watched as He was taken up and a cloud hid Him from their sight
verses.literalPt: Tendo dito essas coisas, foi Jesus elevado à vista deles, e uma nuvem o recebeu e ocultou aos seus olhos.

verses.original: καὶ ὡς ἀτενίζοντες ἦσαν εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν πορευομένου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνδρες δύο παρειστήκεισαν αὐτοῖς ἐν ἐσθήσεσι λευκαῖς
verses.transliteration: kai hōs atenizontes ēsan eis ton ouranon poreuomenou autou kai idou andres dyo pareistēkeisan autois en esthēsesi leukais
verses.literal: They were looking intently into the sky as He was going when suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them
verses.literalPt: Estando eles com os olhos fitos no céu, enquanto ele subia, eis que dois varões com vestiduras brancas se puseram ao lado deles

verses.original: οἳ καὶ εἶπαν Ἄνδρες Γαλιλαῖοι τί ἑστήκατε βλέποντες εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν οὗτος ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὁ ἀναλημφθεὶς ἀφ’ ὑμῶν εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν οὕτως ἐλεύσεται ὃν τρόπον ἐθεάσασθε αὐτὸν πορευόμενον εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν
verses.transliteration: hoi kai eipan Andres Galilaioi ti hestēkate blepontes eis ton ouranon houtos ho Iēsous ho analēmphtheis aph’ hymōn eis ton ouranon houtōs eleusetai hon tropon etheasasthe auton poreuomenon eis ton ouranon
verses.literal: Men of Galilee - they said why do you stand here looking into the sky This same Jesus who has been taken from you into heaven will come back in the same way . . . you have seen Him go into heaven
verses.literalPt: e lhes perguntaram: Galileus, por que estais olhando para o céu? Esse Jesus que dentre vós foi recebido no céu assim virá do modo como o vistes ir para o céu.

verses.original: Τότε ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἀπὸ ὄρους τοῦ καλουμένου Ἐλαιῶνος ὅ ἐστιν ἐγγὺς Ἰερουσαλὴμ σαββάτου ἔχον ὁδόν
verses.transliteration: Tote hypestrepsan eis Ierousalēm apo orous tou kaloumenou Elaiōnos ho estin engys Ierousalēm sabbatou echon hodon
verses.literal: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives which is near the city a Sabbath day’s journey away
verses.literalPt: Então, voltaram para Jerusalém do monte chamado Olival, que está perto de Jerusalém, na distância da jornada de um sábado.

verses.original: καὶ ὅτε εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὸ ὑπερῷον ἀνέβησαν οὗ ἦσαν καταμένοντες ὅ τε Πέτρος καὶ Ἰωάννης καὶ Ἰάκωβος καὶ Ἀνδρέας Φίλιππος καὶ Θωμᾶς Βαρθολομαῖος καὶ Μαθθαῖος Ἰάκωβος Ἁλφαίου καὶ Σίμων ὁ Ζηλωτὴς καὶ Ἰούδας Ἰακώβου
verses.transliteration: kai hote eisēlthon eis to hyperōon anebēsan hou ēsan katamenontes ho te Petros kai Iōannēs kai Iakōbos kai Andreas Philippos kai Thōmas Bartholomaios kai Maththaios Iakōbos Halphaiou kai Simōn ho Zēlōtēs kai Ioudas Iakōbou
verses.literal: When they arrived they went to the upper room where they were staying - Peter and John James and Andrew Philip and Thomas Bartholomew and Matthew James son of Alphaeus Simon the Zealot and Judas son of James
verses.literalPt: Quando entraram, subiram ao cenáculo, onde assistiam Pedro, João, Tiago e André; Filipe, Tomé, Bartolomeu e Mateus; Tiago, filho de Alfeu, e Simão, o zelote, e Judas, filho de Tiago.

verses.original: οὗτοι πάντες ἦσαν προσκαρτεροῦντες ὁμοθυμαδὸν τῇ προσευχῇ σὺν γυναιξὶν καὶ Μαριὰμ τῇ μητρὶ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ σὺν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: houtoi pantes ēsan proskarterountes homothymadon tē proseuchē syn gynaixin kai Mariam tē mētri tou Iēsou kai syn tois adelphois autou
verses.literal: With one accord they all continued in prayer along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus and with His brothers
verses.literalPt: Todos estes perseveravam unanimemente em oração com as mulheres, e com Maria, mãe de Jesus, e com os irmãos dele.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ταύταις ἀναστὰς Πέτρος ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἀδελφῶν εἶπεν ἦν τε ὄχλος ὀνομάτων ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ὡσεὶ ἑκατὸν εἴκοσι
verses.transliteration: Kai en tais hēmerais tautais anastas Petros en mesō tōn adelphōn eipen ēn te ochlos onomatōn epi to auto hōsei hekaton eikosi
verses.literal: In those days Peter stood up among the brothers ( a gathering of . . . about a hundred and twenty ) and said
verses.literalPt: Naqueles dias, levantou-se Pedro no meio dos irmãos (estava ali reunida uma multidão de cerca de cento e vinte pessoas) e disse:

verses.original: Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί ἔδει πληρωθῆναι τὴν γραφὴν ἣν προεῖπεν τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον διὰ στόματος Δαυὶδ περὶ Ἰούδα τοῦ γενομένου ὁδηγοῦ τοῖς συλλαβοῦσιν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: Andres adelphoi edei plērōthēnai tēn graphēn hēn proeipen to Pneuma to Hagion dia stomatos Dauid peri Iouda tou genomenou hodēgou tois syllabousin Iēsoun
verses.literal: Brothers the Scripture had to be fulfilled that the Holy Spirit foretold through the mouth of David concerning Judas who became a guide for those who arrested Jesus
verses.literalPt: Irmãos, convinha que se cumprisse a Escritura que o Espírito Santo predisse por boca de Davi acerca de Judas, que foi o guia daqueles que prenderam a Jesus

verses.original: ὅτι κατηριθμημένος ἦν ἐν ἡμῖν καὶ ἔλαχεν τὸν κλῆρον τῆς διακονίας ταύτης
verses.transliteration: hoti katērithmēmenos ēn en hēmin kai elachen ton klēron tēs diakonias tautēs
verses.literal: He was one of our number and shared . . . . . . in this ministry
verses.literalPt: porque era ele contado entre nós e tomou parte neste ministério.

verses.original: Οὗτος μὲν οὖν ἐκτήσατο χωρίον ἐκ μισθοῦ τῆς ἀδικίας καὶ πρηνὴς γενόμενος ἐλάκησεν μέσος καὶ ἐξεχύθη πάντα τὰ σπλάγχνα αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Houtos men oun ektēsato chōrion ek misthou tēs adikias kai prēnēs genomenos elakēsen mesos kai exechythē panta ta splanchna autou
verses.literal: Now with the reward for his wickedness Judas bought a field there he fell headlong and burst open in the middle and all his intestines spilled out
verses.literalPt: (Ora, esse homem adquiriu um campo com o preço da sua iniquidade e, precipitando-se de cabeça para baixo, arrebentou pelo meio, e todas as suas entranhas se derramaram;

verses.original: καὶ γνωστὸν ἐγένετο πᾶσι τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Ἰερουσαλήμ ὥστε κληθῆναι τὸ χωρίον ἐκεῖνο τῇ ἰδίᾳ διαλέκτῳ αὐτῶν Ἁκελδαμάχ τοῦτ’ ἔστιν Χωρίον αἵματος
verses.transliteration: kai gnōston egeneto pasi tois katoikousin Ierousalēm hōste klēthēnai to chōrion ekeino tē idia dialektō autōn Hakeldamach tout’ estin Chōrion haimatos
verses.literal: This became known to all who lived in Jerusalem so they called that field in their own language Akeldama that is Field of Blood
verses.literalPt: e tornou-se isso conhecido de todos os habitantes de Jerusalém, de maneira que em sua própria língua esse campo era chamado Aceldama, isto é, Campo de Sangue.)

verses.original: Γέγραπται γὰρ ἐν βίβλῳ Ψαλμῶν Γενηθήτω ἡ ἔπαυλις αὐτοῦ ἔρημος καὶ μὴ ἔστω ὁ κατοικῶν ἐν αὐτῇ Καί Τὴν ἐπισκοπὴν αὐτοῦ λαβέτω ἕτερος
verses.transliteration: Gegraptai gar en biblō Psalmōn Genēthētō hē epaulis autou erēmos kai mē estō ho katoikōn en autē Kai Tēn episkopēn autou labetō heteros
verses.literal: For it is written in the book of Psalms May his place be deserted let there be no one to dwell in it and May another take his position
verses.literalPt: Pois está escrito no livro dos Salmos: Fique deserta a sua habitação, e não haja quem nela habite; e: Tome outro o seu ministério.

verses.original: Δεῖ οὖν τῶν συνελθόντων ἡμῖν ἀνδρῶν ἐν παντὶ χρόνῳ ᾧ εἰσῆλθεν καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς ὁ Κύριος Ἰησοῦς
verses.transliteration: Dei oun tōn synelthontōn hēmin andrōn en panti chronō hō eisēlthen kai exēlthen eph’ hēmas ho Kyrios Iēsous
verses.literal: Therefore it is necessary to choose one of the men who have accompanied us the whole time the Lord Jesus went in and out among us
verses.literalPt: É necessário, pois, que, dos homens que nos acompanharam todo o tempo em que o Senhor Jesus viveu entre nós,

verses.original: ἀρξάμενος ἀπὸ τοῦ βαπτίσματος Ἰωάννου ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ἧς ἀνελήμφθη ἀφ’ ἡμῶν μάρτυρα τῆς ἀναστάσεως αὐτοῦ σὺν ἡμῖν γενέσθαι ἕνα τούτων
verses.transliteration: arxamenos apo tou baptismatos Iōannou heōs tēs hēmeras hēs anelēmphthē aph’ hēmōn martyra tēs anastaseōs autou syn hēmin genesthai hena toutōn
verses.literal: beginning from John’s baptism until the day Jesus was taken up from us For one of these must become a witness with us of His resurrection
verses.literalPt: começando desde o batismo de João até o dia em que dentre nós foi recebido acima, um destes se torne testemunha conosco da sua ressurreição.

verses.original: Καὶ ἔστησαν δύο Ἰωσὴφ τὸν καλούμενον Βαρσαββᾶν ὃς ἐπεκλήθη Ἰοῦστος καὶ Μαθθίαν
verses.transliteration: Kai estēsan dyo Iōsēph ton kaloumenon Barsabban hos epeklēthē Ioustos kai Maththian
verses.literal: So they proposed two men Joseph called Barsabbas ( also known as Justus) and Matthias
verses.literalPt: Apresentaram dois — José, também chamado Barsabás, que tinha por sobrenome Justo, e Matias.

verses.original: καὶ προσευξάμενοι εἶπαν Σὺ Κύριε καρδιογνῶστα πάντων ἀνάδειξον ὃν ἐξελέξω ἐκ τούτων τῶν δύο ἕνα
verses.transliteration: kai proseuxamenoi eipan Sy Kyrie kardiognōsta pantōn anadeixon hon exelexō ek toutōn tōn dyo hena
verses.literal: And they prayed Lord You know everyone’s heart . . . Show us which . . . of these two You have chosen
verses.literalPt: E, orando, disseram: Tu, Senhor, que conheces os corações de todos, mostra qual destes dois tens escolhido,

verses.original: λαβεῖν τὸν τόπον τῆς διακονίας ταύτης καὶ ἀποστολῆς ἀφ’ ἧς παρέβη Ἰούδας πορευθῆναι εἰς τὸν τόπον τὸν ἴδιον
verses.transliteration: labein ton topon tēs diakonias tautēs kai apostolēs aph’ hēs parebē Ioudas poreuthēnai eis ton topon ton idion
verses.literal: to take up . . . . . . this ministry and apostleship which Judas abandoned to go to his rightful place
verses.literalPt: para tomar o lugar deste ministério e apostolado, do qual Judas se transviou para ir ao seu próprio lugar.

verses.original: καὶ ἔδωκαν κλήρους αὐτοῖς καὶ ἔπεσεν ὁ κλῆρος ἐπὶ Μαθθίαν καὶ συνκατεψηφίσθη μετὰ τῶν ἕνδεκα ἀποστόλων
verses.transliteration: kai edōkan klērous autois kai epesen ho klēros epi Maththian kai synkatepsēphisthē meta tōn hendeka apostolōn
verses.literal: Then they cast lots . . . and the lot fell to Matthias So he was added to the eleven apostles
verses.literalPt: A respeito deles deitaram sortes; caiu a sorte sobre Matias, e foi ele contado com os onze apóstolos.
